name: Exp_ColorMETRO_MMRec_Duplex
summary: This EA trades both directions (duplex) based on the ColorMETRO trend indicator signals, incorporating money management with recovery logic (MMRec). It systematically enters long or short positions when the ColorMETRO indicator changes color to signal trend direction, and applies position sizing and recovery mechanisms after losses.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorMETRO趋势指标信号进行双向交易(Duplex),并结合带有恢复逻辑的资金管理(MMRec)。当ColorMETRO指标变色指示趋势方向时,系统性地开立多头或空头仓位,并在亏损后应用仓位调整和恢复机制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorMETRO指标的颜色变化来判断趋势方向,该指标通常以多色柱状或线条显示市场趋势状态。入场条件为当指标颜色从一种状态转变为另一种状态时开仓,例如从下跌色转为上涨色时做多,反之做空。Duplex设计意味着EA同时或交替在两个方向上交易,不限制单一方向。出场条件可能包括指标颜色再次反转、固定止盈止损、或尾随止损。仓位管理方面,MMRec表示资金管理恢复机制,可能在亏损后调整仓位大小以尝试回本,这类似于温和的马丁格尔策略但可能有上限控制。资金管理可能包括固定手数、风险百分比或基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。整体策略属于趋势跟踪型,但MMRec恢复机制增加了资金管理的复杂性,在连续亏损时可能加大仓位导致风险累积。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on color changes of the ColorMETRO indicator to determine trend direction, which typically displays market trend states as multi-colored bars or lines. Entry conditions trigger when the indicator color transitions from one state to another, such as going long when the color shifts from bearish to bullish, and vice versa for shorts. The Duplex design means the EA trades in both directions either simultaneously or alternately, not restricting to a single direction. Exit conditions likely include the indicator color reversing again, fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels, or trailing stops. For position sizing, MMRec indicates a money management recovery mechanism that may adjust lot sizes after losses to attempt recovery, similar to a mild martingale approach but potentially with upper limit controls. Money management may include fixed lots, risk percentage, or dynamic position sizing based on account balance. The overall strategy is trend-following in nature, but the MMRec recovery mechanism adds complexity to money management and may increase position sizes during consecutive losses, leading to accumulated risk.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description: 初始手数/固定交易手数

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Overall take profit target in points

parameters.name: MMRecoveryFactor
parameters.description: 亏损后恢复乘数,用于调整下一笔交易手数
parameters.description_en: Post-loss recovery multiplier for adjusting next lot size

parameters.name: MaxRecoverySteps
parameters.description: 最大恢复步数,限制连续加仓次数
parameters.description_en: Maximum recovery steps, limits consecutive additions

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA唯一标识符,用于区分不同EA的订单

pros: 基于ColorMETRO指标的趋势跟踪逻辑较为清晰,入场信号直观易懂
Duplex双向交易设计能够在上涨和下跌行情中均获利,不错过任何趋势方向
设有MaxRecoverySteps限制恢复步数,避免无限加仓导致账户爆仓
pros_en: Trend-following logic based on ColorMETRO indicator is clear and intuitive, with straightforward entry signals
Duplex dual-direction design enables profiting from both uptrends and downtrends without missing any trend direction
MaxRecoverySteps limits recovery steps, preventing unlimited position increases that could blow the account
cons: MMRec恢复机制本质上是一种亏损加仓策略,连续亏损时仓位会以乘数增长,风险较高
依赖单一指标(ColorMETRO)进行交易决策,缺乏多维度确认,容易在震荡市中频繁假信号亏损
趋势跟踪策略在区间震荡市场中会产生大量虚假信号和连续亏损,触发恢复机制后风险急剧放大
cons_en: The MMRec recovery mechanism is essentially a loss-increasing strategy where positions grow multiplicatively during consecutive losses, posing significant risk
Relies on a single indicator (ColorMETRO) for trading decisions without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to frequent false signals in choppy markets
Trend-following strategies generate numerous false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets, which triggers the recovery mechanism and rapidly amplifies risk
improvements: 增加多指标确认机制(如RSI、MACD、ATR)以过滤假信号,减少在震荡市中的无效交易
将MMRec恢复机制替换为基于ATR的动态仓位管理,根据市场波动性调整仓位而非根据亏损历史
增加市场状态识别模块,在震荡区间中暂停交易或切换至均值回归策略
improvements_en: Add multi-indicator confirmation (e.g., RSI, MACD, ATR) to filter false signals and reduce ineffective trades in choppy markets
Replace the MMRec recovery mechanism with ATR-based dynamic position sizing that adjusts lots based on market volatility rather than loss history
Add a market regime detection module to pause trading during ranging periods or switch to a mean-reversion strategy

risk_points: MMRec恢复机制在连续亏损时会逐步加大仓位,虽然有限制但仍存在较大回撤风险
单一指标依赖在趋势转震荡时会产生连续亏损信号,叠加恢复机制可能导致快速资金消耗
缺乏新K线检查机制可能导致同一根K线内多次开仓重复信号
risk_points_en: MMRec recovery mechanism progressively increases position sizes during consecutive losses, and while limited, still poses significant drawdown risk
Single-indicator dependency generates consecutive losing signals when trends transition to ranges, compounding with the recovery mechanism to potentially rapidly deplete capital
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same bar from repeated signals

summary_en: This EA trades both directions (duplex) based on the ColorMETRO trend indicator signals, incorporating money management with recovery logic (MMRec). It systematically enters long or short positions when the ColorMETRO indicator changes color to signal trend direction, and applies position sizing and recovery mechanisms after losses.
